summary: Thunder Mountain Gold, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 8,090,451 units at US$0.70 per unit, raising gross proceeds of US$5,663,316. Each unit comprised one common share and one-half warrant exercisable at US$1.00 for 24 months. A cash finder's fee of US$66,563 and 94,089 finder warrants were issued to Canadian brokers. Proceeds will fund drilling and surveys at the South Mountain Project. The offering was conducted outside the U.S. under Regulation S, with securities subject to restricted legends and Canadian regulatory hold periods. What to watch: final TSX Venture Exchange approval and project advancement news.
